entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior-poet and planeswalker who visits Kaladesh and meets Saheeli.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer on Kaladesh, known to crowds, who takes Huatli to her workshop to make a dinosaur.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker and blacksmith who returns home to his foundry and his daughters.

entities.name: Rumi
entities.description: One of Angrath's minotaur daughters, a blacksmith.

entities.name: Jamira
entities.description: One of Angrath's minotaur daughters, a blacksmith.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who returns to Ravnica and, memories hidden, deceives Nicol Bolas into trusting her.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who rewards Vraska with the title of guildleader, not realizing her memories have been altered.

entities.name: Jarad Vod Savo
entities.description: A target Vraska plans to petrify.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and Living Guildpact who bids farewell to Ixalan and planeswalks to Dominaria to find Gideon.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A crew member of the Belligerent to whom Jace sends a farewell message.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A crew member of the Belligerent.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Jace's friend and fellow planeswalker, overjoyed to see him alive.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose thought now fills Jace with dread.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The dragon whom Jace worries about confronting.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: The sphinx whose chamber Jace stood in.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec III
entities.description: The Sun Empire's emperor who occupies Orazca and declares a new age of conquest.

entities.name: Aether Regulator
entities.description: A medical device that eases dissipation symptoms for aetherborn, presented in Ghirapur.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact that vanished from Orazca.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: An ingenious aether-powered plane Huatli visits.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A bustling inventors' city on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Huatli's and Jace's recent plane.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Vraska's and Jace's home plane.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Jace finds Gideon.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: A watery plane where Vraska meets Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city claimed by Apatzec.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampires' continent Apatzec names as next.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire that claims Orazca.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk who did not try to hold Orazca.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Jace hopes to rejoin.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's ship.

events.summary: Huatli arrives in a bustling inventors' city on Kaladesh.
events.quote: She emerged into a city unlike any she had seen before.

events.summary: Huatli watches an aetherborn inventor unveil the aether regulator.
events.quote: It is a medical device that will ease uncomfortable symptoms of dissipation

events.summary: Saheeli, a fellow planeswalker, pulls Huatli aside and introduces herself.
events.quote: My name is Saheeli.

events.summary: Saheeli names the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
events.quote: This plane is Kaladesh, and this city is Ghirapur.

events.summary: Saheeli takes Huatli to her workshop to make a dinosaur.
events.quote: We are going back to my workshop right now so you can describe them to me.

events.summary: Angrath returns to his hometown and foundry.
events.quote: It was a sleepy sort of place, and Angrath was happy very little had changed.

events.summary: Angrath reunites with his daughters Rumi and Jamira.
events.quote: Rumi. Jamira. I'm home.

events.summary: Vraska returns to her chamber on Ravnica after the portal closes.
events.quote: she was standing back in her own chamber on Ravnica.

events.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
events.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

events.summary: Vraska meets Nicol Bolas on the meditation plane.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas was waiting for her.

events.summary: Bolas scours Vraska's mind and replays her Ixalan memories.
events.quote: He peered into each corner of her memories of Ixalan and replayed them all in the blink of an eye.

events.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
events.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

events.summary: Bolas rewards Vraska with a kingdom of her own design.
events.quote: You have earned a kingdom of your own design.

events.summary: Vraska feels uneasy that she may be missing something.
events.quote: She felt unsettled, though she could not remember anything that might be missing . . . or why.

events.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
events.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

events.summary: Vraska prepares to petrify Jarad.
events.quote: and contemplated what she ought to say to Jarad before she petrified him.

events.summary: Jace stays invisible as the Sun vanishes and the others leave.
events.quote: Jace had shrouded himself in invisibility as the Immortal Sun vanished

events.summary: Jace sends Malcolm a farewell message for the crew.
events.quote: Captain is safe, but far away

events.summary: Jace thinks of the promised coffee and book with Vraska.
events.quote: His mind drifted to the promise of coffee and a book.

events.summary: Jace resolves that Ravnica must come first.
events.quote: Ravnica must come first.

events.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
events.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

events.summary: Jace planeswalks and lands aboard a fast-moving vessel on Dominaria.
events.quote: Jace stepped through the aether forcefully and immediately caught himself on a wall.

events.summary: Gideon is overjoyed to see Jace alive.
events.quote: Gideon! I'm not dead!

events.summary: An older woman in red robes blocks Gideon and asks who Jace is.
events.quote: Who's the bookworm?

events.summary: Apatzec sends knights to clear Orazca and finds it empty.
events.quote: He had immediately sent a battalion of his strongest knights to clear the city

events.summary: Apatzec enters Orazca at the head of a procession.
events.quote: The trees gave way to pillars of endless gold as they entered the city.

events.summary: Apatzec declares Orazca the Sun Empire's again and names Torrezon as next.
events.quote: Ixalan is ours . . . and Torrezon is next.

relations.note: They become friends and work together on a dinosaur.
relations.quote: The two Planeswalkers happily walked back to Saheeli's workshop.
You will be rewarded for your loyalty.

relations.note: Gideon is overjoyed to see Jace.
Malcolm calls Jace an excellent pirate and crewmate.
relations.quote: You'll always be a crewmate, Jace

relations.note: Declares a new age of conquest.
relations.quote: The three aspects of the sun shine bright, and thus begins a new age of conquest for the Sun Empire.

relations.note: Jace looks forward to coffee and a book with her.
relations.quote: His mind drifted to the promise of coffee and a book.
